cohort: The study included 25 pregnant women with isolated Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR) and 194 pregnant women with uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: Pregnancies complicated by IUGR had significantly higher maternal serum leptin concentrations and significantly lower cord blood leptin concentrations at delivery compared to normal pregnancies.
birth_weight: Birth weight was analyzed; a strong correlation was observed between cord blood leptin concentrations and birth weight in normal pregnancies.
